title: MultiComboBox
description: Fiori multi combo box: tokens plus a filterable check box list, "show selected" via n more, select all and the SAP keyboard model.

usage.summary: Select several predefined options from a filterable list and display selections as tokens.
useWhen: Let users select several predefined values from fewer than 200 options while typing narrows the list.
Keep selected values visible as tokens and prevent unmatched text from becoming selected options.
Offer selection of the whole set only when it helps the task.
Control selectedValues with onSelectionChange separately from typed value; noValidation allows unmatched text but does not select it.

avoidWhen.when: Choose one value: Select covers 2–12 fixed options without typing (sort alphabetically above 8), ComboBox covers type-ahead across 20–200, and Input covers text without suggestions.
Collect arbitrary or caller-validated entries, or work with a dataset above 200; provide caller-managed tokens and optional value help.
Search above 200 business entries by several attributes or define ranges and conditions.
Navigate and remove existing tokens without adding values through a choice list.
